title: Aethermancer Demo
notes: This is the demo of Aethermancer, by moi rai games. Unity 2022.3.0f1 game.
session: Played for 90 min, launched from macOS Steam through Proton-ish.
issues: Short frame hiccups here and there, one of them a drop of about 2 seconds; otherwise about 95% smooth at 100 fps, with no impact on the turn-based play.
